sql: select ev.version, ep.id epoch_id, ep.epoch_number, ep.ended_at ep_end, d.deployment_key, d.kind, d.ended_at, da.strategy_tag from experiments e join experiment_versions ev on ev.experiment_id=e.id join experiment_epochs ep on ep.version_id=ev.id left join experiment_deployments d on d.epoch_id=ep.id left join experiment_deployment_arms da on da.deployment_id=d.id where e.key in ('mmsell-price-ceiling','mmsell-price-ceiling-cell-size') and (ep.ended_at is null or d.ended_at is null) order by e.key, ev.version, ep.epoch_number
